info.name: FarmAgent API (JSON:API)
info.description:
FarmAgent API collection with JSON:API format - all requests go through the API Gateway at localhost:8000.

Responses follow JSON:API v1.1 spec with:
- Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json
- data/errors/meta top-level
- Resources with type/id/attributes
